examples.chinese: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 找您七百八十五塊錢，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo nín qī bǎi bāshíwǔ kuài qián, xièxie.
examples.english: Here is your 785 dollars of change, thanks.

examples.chinese: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

examples.chinese: 好，謝謝醫生。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
examples.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

items.wordHook: 謝(thank), said twice: 謝謝(thank you).

examples.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
examples.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

items.wordHook: 早(early) + 飯(meal) → the early meal is breakfast.

examples.chinese: 我想買一雙黑色的鞋子和一雙白色的襪子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng hēisè de xiézi hé yī shuāng báisè de wàzi.
examples.english: I want to buy a pair of black shoes and a pair of white socks.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 我買了一雙除臭的襪子送給他。 (V)
我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

items.wordHook: 禮拜 means week. It comes from 禮(ceremony)+拜(worship), the weekly worship day.

examples.chinese: A:這個照相機是誰的？ B:是我爸爸的。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège zhàoxiàngjī shì shéi de? B: Shì wǒ bàba de.
examples.english: A: Whose camera is this? B: It's my dad's.

examples.chinese: 那個照相機貴得不得了，我買不起。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zhàoxiàngjī guì de bùdéliǎo, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: That camera is extremely expensive; I can't afford to buy it.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 這支手機的照相功能很強，拍出來的效果比照相機還要好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī de zhàoxiàng gōngnéng hěn qiáng, pāi chūlái de xiàoguǒ bǐ zhàoxiàngjī hái yào hǎo.
examples.english: This phone's camera function is very strong; the effect of the photos taken is even better than that of a camera.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 山本良介還在台灣學中文，他的中文課明年二月才結束。我今天有三個小時的數學課，剛剛才下課。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hái zài Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, tā de Zhōngwén kè míngnián èr yuè cái jiéshù. Wǒ jīntiān yǒu sān ge xiǎoshí de shùxué kè, gānggāng cái xiàkè.
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is still studying Chinese in Taiwan; his Chinese course will only end next February. I had three hours of math class today and just got out of class.

examples.chinese: 你剛剛說要吃漢堡，現在說要吃炸雞，到底要吃什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō yào chī hànbǎo, xiànzài shuō yào chī zhàjī, dàodǐ yào chī shénme?
examples.english: You just said you wanted to eat a hamburger, and now you say you want to eat fried chicken—what on earth do you want to eat?

examples.chinese: 他們剛剛在燒竹子的時候，火非常大。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen gānggāng zài shāo zhúzi de shíhou, huǒ fēicháng dà.
examples.english: When they were just burning bamboo, the fire was very big.

examples.chinese: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
你那一付筷子剛剛掉到地上弄髒了，我再幫你換一付新的。
那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

items.wordHook: 這(this) + 麼(particle) → 'this way', so 'so'.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
examples.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 這所大學的外語學院有英文系、日文系、德文系和義大利文系。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué de wàiyǔ xuéyuàn yǒu Yīngwén xì, Rìwén xì, Déwén xì hé Yìdàlìwén xì.
examples.english: This university's College of Foreign Languages has an English department, a Japanese department, a German department, and an Italian department.

examples.chinese: 這本書的內容很有意思，介紹了很多義大利的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒu yìsi, jièshàole hěn duō Yìdàlì de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: The content of this book is very interesting; it introduces a lot of Italian food culture.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 那家義大利餐廳太貴了，除非打折，要不然我不會去。
[{"chinese":"老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
我的球隊因為練習不夠，這一季的表現也不太理想。
華語文中心的學生邀請台灣朋友來參加世界文化日的活動。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng yāoqǐng Táiwān péngyou lái cānjiā shìjiè wénhuà rì de huódòng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center invited Taiwanese friends to come participate in the World Culture Day activities.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.
examples.english: If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

items.wordHook: Viewing 缺(lack) scenery at this designated 點(point): 缺點 means shortcoming, defect, disadvantage.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
他一有不順心的事，就會嘮叨個沒完，有時真讓人受不了。
坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。

items.wordHook: Finding hardship hard to 受(receive) and 不(no) longer able to endure 了(clear): 受不了 means cannot bear.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡觀察小動物走來走去的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan guānchá xiǎo dòngwù zǒu lái zǒu qù de yàngzi.
examples.english: I like to observe the way small animals walk back and forth.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
那個廚師很有一手，能用一條魚做出五道菜。
廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。

items.wordHook: Working in the 廚(kitchen) as a skilled 師(teacher): 廚師 means cook, chef.

examples.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。

examples.chinese: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
我罵他是因為他太可惡了，你要我別生氣，我真的忍不住。
當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。

items.wordHook: A generous 亻(person) gathers supplies together so community members 共(together) have enough to eat and drink: 供(supply).
a 勹(wrap) rests gently around a sleeping 巳(curl) → 包(wrap).
A strict supervisor 臤(oversee) directs workers to tamp the damp 土(soil) until it turns rock 堅(hard).
Combining 屋(building) and 頂(top): 屋頂 means roof.
工(labor) + 作(do) → doing labor is 工作 "work".
To 教(education) a 材(timber): 教材 means teaching material.
a 木(tree) stands like a 奇(strange) perch → the 椅(chair).
Clear mountain 氵(water) that flows as pure as pristine 青(blue-green) skies is sparkling and 清(clean).
Leather (皮) wrap (包) → a wallet is a leather wrap for your money.
a 糹(silk) takes the 工(work) dye → a wedding banner of 紅(red).
an 耂(old) man counts each 日(sun) at the market gate → 者(person).
醫(doctor) + 院(institution) → the institution for doctors, a hospital.
Combining 隨(follow) and 便(easy): 隨便 means careless.
Combining 颱(platform) and 風(wind): 颱風 means typhoon.
